didYouKnow.title: Did You Know?
didYouKnow.subtitle: Fascinating scientific insights, ASME standards, and fluid mechanics principles.

card1.title: Why do cylindrical pipes and vessels always rupture longitudinally?
card1.description: In thin-walled cylindrical shells, circumferential (hoop) stress is exactly twice the longitudinal stress. When internal pressure exceeds limits, the vessel invariably bursts along its length rather than circumference.

card2.title: 98% particulate separation achieved with zero moving parts!
card2.description: Industrial hydrocyclones transform fluid pressure into extreme rotational velocity, generating centrifugal accelerations thousands of times greater than gravity to separate dense solids within milliseconds.

card3.title: Cavitation: when microscopic vapor bubbles pit hardened steel!
card3.description: When local pressure drops below saturation vapor pressure, microbubbles form and violently collapse upon entering higher pressure zones. The resulting micro-jets exceed 10,000 bar, rapidly eroding titanium impellers.

card4.title: Instant valve closure and devastating water hammer shockwaves!
card4.description: Rapid valve closure converts the kinetic energy of a flowing liquid into acoustic pressure shockwaves, generating instantaneous surge pressures up to 50 bar that can rupture pipelines.

card5.title: Tacoma Narrows collapse: the deadly dance of Karman vortex shedding!
card5.description: Fluid flow past cylindrical structures sheds alternating vortices. When the vortex shedding frequency locks onto the natural structural frequency, catastrophic flow-induced vibration (VIV) resonance occurs.

card6.title: Cooling gas to -60°C simply by passing through a throttling valve!
card6.description: During adiabatic throttling without external work, real gases like methane experience significant temperature drops due to intermolecular attractive forces, eliminating the need for electric refrigeration chillers.

card7.title: Hydrogen embrittlement: catastrophic sour gas pipe failure without warning!
card7.description: In the presence of wet H2S, monatomic hydrogen diffuses into steel crystal lattices, creating localized high-pressure pockets that cause sudden brittle fracture well below yield strength.

card8.title: Massive liquid slug impacts threatening piping elbows at high velocity!
card8.description: In oil and gas transport pipelines, stratified flows can transition into dangerous slug regimes where liquid pistons weighing multiple tons strike pipe elbows at high velocities.

card9.title: Why counter-flow always outperforms co-current flow in heat exchangers?
card9.description: Counter-current heat exchangers maintain a uniform temperature difference across their entire length, allowing the cold fluid exit temperature to surpass the hot fluid exit temperature.

card10.title: Sonic limit: why mass flow rate cannot exceed the sonic velocity threshold!
card10.description: When the downstream to upstream pressure ratio drops below the critical ratio, gas velocity at the nozzle throat reaches Mach 1 (speed of sound), choking mass flow regardless of further downstream pressure drops.

Terms.title: Terms of Use
Terms.subtitle: Please read these terms carefully before using the platform.
Terms.acceptanceBody: By accessing and using the Euroslot Pars engineering and calculation platform, you accept and agree to be bound by the terms and provisions of this agreement. If you do not agree to abide by these terms, you are not authorized to use the services.
Terms.intellectualPropertyBody: All intellectual property rights, designs, proprietary module code, and analytical tools within this platform belong to Euroslot Pars. Any unauthorized copying or commercial use without written permission will result in legal action.
Terms.disclaimerBody: Although our R&D team has made every effort to ensure 100% accuracy in engineering calculations, the results provided are for guidance only. The ultimate responsibility for approving drawings and calculations in real-world projects lies with the supervising engineer.

Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.dataCollectionBody: Our platform (Euroslot Pars) respects user privacy and only collects data necessary to improve the functionality of our engineering and calculation systems. This may include theme preferences, language settings, and project history.
Privacy.useOfCookiesBody: We use cookies to store visual preferences (such as the primary theme color and light/dark mode) and maintain your login state to provide a seamless experience. No sensitive personal data is extracted through this method.
Privacy.yourRightsBody: You have the right to view, modify, or delete your data at any time. For any privacy-related questions or requests, you can contact our R&D support team.
